complexity.notes: Using `valid *= isValidLine(...)` (integer multiplication of booleans) is unidiomatic; `valid = valid and isValidLine(...)` or early returns would be clearer. `line.count(num)` inside the loop is O(9) per call, fine here but a set-based check would be the standard pattern for scalable input.
complexity.summary: Validates each row, column, and 3x3 box by checking for duplicate digits using list.count on each filled cell. Since the board is a fixed 9x9 grid, all work is bounded by a constant.
